Mouni Roy and Suraj Nambiar Divorce Confirmed: Check Out Their Relationship Timeline
Mouni Roy and Suraj Nambiar Divorce Confirmed: Check Out Their Relationship Timeline
Mouni Roy and Suraj Nambiar have officially confirmed their separation after years of marriage. From meeting in Dubai and their intimate Goa wedding to their recent divorce statement, here’s a detailed look at the couple’s relationship timeline and separation announcement.
Team BTMay 15, 2026, 13:22 IST

​Popular actress Mouni Roy and her husband, Suraj Nambiar, have announced their separation via a social media post. Their separation rumours recently went viral on social media after the couple apparently unfollowed each other on Instagram. Suraj had also deactivated his Instagram account, which further fuelled their separation. While the actress had earlier released a statement requesting the media not to spread false narratives, she later made the separation announcement. Here’s looking at Suraj Nambiar and Mouni Roy’s relationship timeline before they decided to part ways.

Suraj Nambiar met Mouni Roy in 2019

The couple met in Dubai in 2019 at a New Year’s party through their mutual friends. They reportedly hit it off immediately and began dating soon after. They kept their relationship private initially and kept their affair a secret.

Mouni Roy was in Dubai throughout COVID-19

Mouni Roy decided to spend her COVID-19 lockdown in Dubai, which fuelled her relationship rumours with Nambiar. After a friend shared a poolside photograph featuring the couple, the stories about their relationship only grew stronger.

Mouni’s Parents Met Suraj in 2021

After a couple of years of dating, Mouni finally decided to take the next step. She introduced her beau to her family in 2021, and the meeting apparently took place at Mandira Bedi’s residence. Soon, rumours of their upcoming wedding started hitting the media circuit.

Mouni and Suraj Nambiar Got Married in 2022

It was in January 2022 when the couple finally decided to settle down. They got married as per Bengali and Malayali traditions in front of their close friends and family. They planned their destination wedding in Goa.

Mouni Roy – Suraj Nambiar’s Separation Statement

The couple, in their statement, insisted that it was a mutual decision. Their statement on Mouni’s Instagram account read, “We note with dismay the unnecessary and intrusive attention into our personal lives by certain quarters of the media. We would like to state that we have decided to part ways and are taking the necessary time to address matters privately and amicably."
